critical_correction: The first bounded run had an output-indexing bug: Marabou maps the composed two-output net as Y_0..9=logits, Y_10..793=pixels (the reverse of the onnxruntime graph output order). The original spec clamped logits to [0,1] and asserted confusion between two pixels, so its verdicts were invalid. Caught by the requested indexing validation, fixed in emit_bounded, re-validated on 5 anchors (confusion-only at Y_0..9 reproduces the unbounded R4 verdict exactly), and re-run.
indexing_validation: external_mnistfc_output_indexing_validation.json (logits Y_0..9, pixels Y_10..793; 5/5 anchors match unbounded verdict)
monotonic_sanity: external_mnistfc_monotonic_sanity.json (38 SAT witnesses: 23 clear confusion + 15 within 0.05 logit of the boundary; consistent, no bug)

corrected_result.region: R4 local-PCA at 1 sigma with valid-pixel constraints (0<=x_i<=1 on reconstructed pixels Y_10..793), 600 s budget
corrected_result.anchors: the 11 held-out anchors where R1@0.05 (broad pixel ball) is SAT
corrected_result.R4_bounded_1sigma_status: UNSAT on 11/11 (resolved in 32-390 s, zero timeouts)

comparison.note: Valid-pixel constraints make the removal MORE complete (11/11) than the unbounded region (6/11): the unbounded SAT witnesses on the other anchors were out-of-cube and disappear when pixels are bounded.

R3_dropped: R3 (class-AE latent box) is not used to support external transfer; even with correct indexing it is solver-heavy. External transfer is framed around bounded R4 only.
claim: Bounded local-PCA removes broad-region class-confusion witnesses on an external image classifier we did not train: R4 at 1 sigma with valid-pixel constraints enforced is UNSAT on all 11 anchors where the broad pixel ball admits a witness.
